name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
desc:
When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.
Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

value.name: Memory Core Rewards
value.desc: Countless replicas of Civilizations drift through this place, suspended in the windless instant before their extinction. The cold Pillar Hall stands in silent vigil, no less taciturn than its master. None can discern the true purpose behind this realm, shaped by the Lord of Emptiness — colorless, formless, without thought, desire, or will. Yet if the scattered Memory Factors of those forgotten echoes were to be gathered here once more, perhaps an unforeseen gift born of space and the memories of Civilizations would reveal itself...
